entities.name: Ribosomal RNA methyltransferase G
observations: The 218-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q72CN3 and A1VEG3, annotated as ribosomal RNA small subunit methyltransferase G.
The query contains a GidB domain (Pfam PF02527.22) at residues 28–178.
Reference annotation assigns cytoplasmic localization and rRNA guanine-N7 methyltransferase activity (EC 2.1.1.170).

entities.name: 16S rRNA G527 methylation
observations: Reference reaction: 16S rRNA guanosine 527 + S-adenosyl-L-methionine → N7-methylguanosine 527 in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (Rhea RHEA:42732).
